column1: # Price overrides — the lowest tier, shipped with the repo.
# A harness names its models however it likes, and some of those names reach no
# entry in models.dev by any transformation. This file says what a name is,
# once, so the lookup stops guessing.
#   <model as the harness names it>   <TAB>   moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code
#   <model as the harness names it>   <TAB>   0.95 0.19 0.95 4
# The first form is an alias into models.dev, so the rates stay current. Prefer
# it. The second form is four rates in dollars per million tokens — input,
# cache read, cache write, output — for a model nobody publishes.
# A rate line may end in any of `from <UTC instant>`, `at <UTC hours>` and
# `on <provider>`, for a seller whose price moves on a calendar or a clock.
# Hour ranges are half-open, as a clock reads them: `01-04` is 01:00 up to
# 04:00. Several lines may name one model; of those that fit the moment being
# priced, the nearest source wins, then the latest `from`, then the one that
# names hours. Nothing fits means the catalogue answers, so a rate that starts
# on a date leaves the history before it alone.
# Precedence, highest first:
#   RIG_AI_PRICE_<model with non-alphanumerics as underscores>  (environment)
#   ~/.config/rig-telemetry/prices.tsv                          (yours)
#   this file
#   models.dev, matched directly
# `rig ai doctor` prints the exact line to add for anything still unpriced.
# Kimi Code sells plans, and the plan name is the model name on the wire.
# config.toml carries the mapping in display_name: "K2.7 Coding".
kimi-code/kimi-for-coding
kimi-code/kimi-for-coding-highspeed
kimi-for-coding
kimi-for-coding-highspeed
# DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak from 16:00 UTC on 2026-08-16, off-peak at
# half the peak rate. Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC. models.dev
# publishes one number per model and cannot say which, so the clock lives here.
# Cache write repeats the input rate: DeepSeek charges a miss at plain input.
# https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
deepseek-v4-pro
deepseek-v4-pro
deepseek-v4-flash
deepseek-v4-flash
# OpenRouter passes DeepSeek's own peak/off-peak clock straight through for the
# 0813 build, so the same clock the `on deepseek` lines carry is repeated here
# scoped to openrouter. models.dev still lists the pre-cutover 0.435/0.87, which
# is wrong for anything after 2026-08-16T16:00Z.
deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813
deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813
# Qwen3.8 27B shipped 2026-08-14, after the models.dev snapshot this stack
# prices from, so no catalogue entry reaches it. OpenRouter's list rate:
# https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen3.8-27b
qwen/qwen3.8-27b
